Messages.Author: Geoff
Messages.Body:
There is a prophecy card that allows a vampire to hunt off of a
younger vampire as a D action. As it states a 'D action', there is no
stealth on this correct?

Same question on the similarily worded gehenna card.

I reasoned that the default hunt action comes at +1 stealth as per the
rules, but alternate hunt actions have the stealth (if any) as
described by the card/rule that provides it.

G

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Geoff wrote:
> There is a prophecy card that allows a vampire to hunt off of a
> younger vampire as a D action. As it states a 'D action', there is no
> stealth on this correct?

Correct. Compare to Legacy of Caine, which says, "...as a (D)
action...", but lacks the +1 stealth, and contrast to Kyoko, which says
"...as a +1 stealth (D) action".

--Colin McGuigan
